question_text: A P5,000 investment earned P750 simple interest over 3 years. Annual rate?

hint_ladder.title: Simple Interest Formula
hint_ladder.text: Gamitin ang I = P × r × t. Dito, I=750, P=5,000, t=3 taon. Hanapin ang r.

hint_ladder.title: I-match sa Options
hint_ladder.text: Ang 5% ay Option B. Iwasan ang 4%, 6%, o 7%—maaaring dahil maling interes o formula.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you used P600 interest instead of 750; 600÷15000=0.04=4%. Always check the given values.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you used P900 interest, 900÷15000=0.06; maybe added 150 to the given P750.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you forgot to divide by 3, so 750÷5000=0.15, then incorrectly converted to 7%.

next_time_rule: Bago mag-solve ng interest, isulat ang I = Prt. Siguraduhing tugma ang units ng oras (taon) at principal. I-plug at i-solve nang maingat.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo, si Aleng Nena nagdeposito ng P5,000 sa rural bank ng barangay para sa 3-taong time deposit. Pagkatapos, may P750 siyang interes. Gaano kabilis lumago ang pera niya? Sagot: ang annual simple interest rate.

Formula ng simple interest: I = P × r × t. Ang I ay interest (P750), P ay principal (P5,000), t ay oras sa taon (3). Kailangan hanapin ang r.

I-rearrange: r = I ÷ (P × t) = 750 ÷ (5,000 × 3) = 750 ÷ 15,000. I-divide: 750/15,000 = 0.05.

Convert sa percent: 0.05 × 100 = 5%. Kaya ang annual simple interest rate ay 5%—Option B.

**Watch-Out Zone: order_of_operations_error** Hatiin sa t! r=I/(P×t), hindi I/P.
